services.value: UC Laboratory provides environmental testing including “Wastewater Biosolid Analysis,” “Pathogen Reduction,” “Drinking Water,” “Ground Water Microbiological,” “Lakes & Rivers,” “Soil Analysis,” and “Stormwater Analysis (MPCA Compliant).” It also offers field services such as “On-site Wastewater Sampling,” “Groundwater Monitoring,” and “Flow Measurement Studies,” along with “functional testing services” for software and applications.
